ACME INTERVAL FUND

Notice of Repurchase Offer dated August 14, 2026.

Repurchase Request DeadlineSeptember 12, 2026
Repurchase Pricing DateSeptember 15, 2026
Repurchase Payment DateSeptember 22, 2026

All repurchase requests must be received by the Fund no later than 5:00 p.m. Eastern time on September 12, 2026.

The Fund is a closed-end management investment company. Its investment objective is long-term capital appreciation through a diversified portfolio of privately originated credit instruments. Shares are not listed on any exchange and no secondary market for them exists or is expected to develop.

Investors should read the prospectus carefully before investing. Past performance does not guarantee future results. An investment in the Fund involves risk, including the possible loss of the entire amount invested, and is suitable only for investors who can bear such a loss.

The Fund was organized on March 3, 1998 and has no further obligations.
